prompts.title: Write a weekly report
prompts.prompt: Look at the past week's Git commits in the workspace and organize them by project into a weekly report: what was done, problems met, plans for next week. Output in Markdown.

prompts.title: Learn a language in two weeks
prompts.prompt: I want to get started with Rust in two weeks. Give me a day-by-day study plan with one small exercise a day, and walk me through day one's exercise right now.

prompts.title: Write a README for a project
prompts.prompt: Read the project in the workspace and write a README: a one-line intro, features, installation, usage examples and the directory layout.

prompts.title: Plan a trip
prompts.prompt: Plan a three-day trip to Hangzhou for me: the route for each day, transport, what to eat, and a budget estimate. I like places with fewer crowds.
